name: Browser research — cross-review
description: Two bound browser conversations work independently, then reconcile evidence in up to 10 rounds. Browser access and any local actions require their existing permissions.

steps.name: Cross-review evidence and conclusions
steps.promptTemplate:
Carefully cross-reference the other participant's complete augmented answer, including executed actions and results, against your own findings. Resolve every confirmed discrepancy. Return JSON only with fields candidate, accepted, objections, and unresolvedRisks. candidate is the exact proposed result. accepted is boolean. objections and unresolvedRisks are string arrays. Accept only the candidate you are returning.
